quests.title: Hogger’s Raiders
quests.text: Gnolls raid the farms south of Goldshire, and Hogger grows bolder every night. Bring the brute down and break the raiders who follow him.

quests.title: Bounty: Murloc Streamrunners
quests.text: Murloc Streamrunners keep coming at Goldshire. Marshal Dughan pays for every thirty you put down, as often as you bring proof.

quests.title: Break the Lairs
quests.text: Four lairs ring the battlefield, each held by a champion. Break three of them and Goldshire sleeps easier.

quests.title: Hold the Line
quests.text: Marshal Dughan needs the field held while Goldshire regroups. Survive ten minutes in Elwynn Forest, whatever comes.

quests.title: The Collector
quests.text: Morgan the Collector runs the racket that bleeds Elwynn dry, and every thug on the road answers to him. End it.

quests.title: Proven in Elwynn Forest
quests.text: Marshal Dughan trusts only those who have grown strong in the field. Reach level 15 in a single run in Elwynn Forest.

quests.title: The Howler
quests.text: Edan the Howler hunts the passes above Kharanos, and the whole pack follows its call. Silence it and thin the pack.

quests.title: Bounty: Wendigos
quests.text: Wendigos keep coming at Kharanos. Senir Whitebeard pays for every thirty you put down, as often as you bring proof.

quests.title: Break the Lairs
quests.text: Four lairs ring the battlefield, each held by a champion. Break three of them and Kharanos sleeps easier.

quests.title: Hold the Line
quests.text: Senir Whitebeard needs the field held while Kharanos regroups. Survive ten minutes in Dun Morogh, whatever comes.

quests.title: The White Bear
quests.text: Bjarn, the great white bear, has come down from the peaks. Nothing in the valley is safe while it roams.

quests.title: Proven in Dun Morogh
quests.text: Senir Whitebeard trusts only those who have grown strong in the field. Reach level 15 in a single run in Dun Morogh.

quests.title: Shadows in the Glen
quests.text: Corruption creeps through the Shadowglen and Threggil feeds on it. Root out the grell and whatever follows in its wake.

quests.title: Bounty: Nightsabers
quests.text: Nightsabers keep coming at the Shadowglen. Conservator Ilthalaine pays for every thirty you put down, as often as you bring proof.

quests.title: Break the Lairs
quests.text: Four lairs ring the battlefield, each held by a champion. Break three of them and the Shadowglen sleeps easier.

quests.title: Hold the Line
quests.text: Conservator Ilthalaine needs the field held while the Shadowglen regroups. Survive ten minutes in Teldrassil, whatever comes.

quests.title: The Augur’s Poison
quests.text: The Gnarlpine Augur poisons the furbolg tribe from within. Silence the Augur and the tribe may yet heal.

quests.title: Proven in Teldrassil
quests.text: Conservator Ilthalaine trusts only those who have grown strong in the field. Reach level 15 in a single run in Teldrassil.

quests.title: The Geolord
quests.text: Geolord Mottle’s quilboar dig in along the Valley of Trials. Break his warband before it reaches Razor Hill.

quests.title: Bounty: Dire Mottled Boars
quests.text: Dire Mottled Boars keep coming at Razor Hill. Gornek pays for every thirty you put down, as often as you bring proof.

quests.title: Break the Lairs

quests.title: Hold the Line
quests.text: Gornek needs the field held while Razor Hill regroups. Survive ten minutes in Durotar, whatever comes.

quests.title: Cult of the Burning Blade
quests.text: The Burning Blade gathers in Skull Rock. Its cultist must fall before the demons answer the call.

quests.title: Proven in Durotar
quests.text: Gornek trusts only those who have grown strong in the field. Reach level 15 in a single run in Durotar.

quests.title: Stalkers of the Plain
quests.text: Stalkers circle the plains below Red Cloud Mesa. Hunt the boldest of them and drive the rest away.

quests.title: Bounty: Venture Co. Hirelings

quests.title: Hold the Line
quests.text: Grull Hawkwind needs the field held while Bloodhoof Village regroups. Survive ten minutes in Mulgore, whatever comes.

quests.title: The Pale Wolf
quests.text: Ghost Howl walks Mulgore at night, and the herds will not graze while it does. Put the spirit to rest.

quests.title: Proven in Mulgore
quests.text: Grull Hawkwind trusts only those who have grown strong in the field. Reach level 15 in a single run in Mulgore.

quests.title: The Farmer’s Field
quests.text: Farmer Solliden still guards his fields, long after the plague took him. The Forsaken need that land.

quests.title: Bounty: Rot Hide Graverobbers
quests.text: Rot Hide Graverobbers keep coming at Brill. Executor Arren pays for every thirty you put down, as often as you bring proof.

quests.title: Break the Lairs

quests.title: Hold the Line
quests.text: Executor Arren needs the field held while Brill regroups. Survive ten minutes in Tirisfal Glades, whatever comes.

quests.title: Gorefang
quests.text: Gorefang, the great worg, haunts the glades between Brill and the Scarlet border. Bring the beast down.

quests.title: Proven in Tirisfal Glades
quests.text: Executor Arren trusts only those who have grown strong in the field. Reach level 15 in a single run in Tirisfal Glades.

quests.title: The Brotherhood’s Voice
quests.text: The Defias Brotherhood holds Westfall in its fist. Start with the Brainwashed Noble who preaches their cause.

quests.title: Bounty: Defias Trappers

quests.title: Break the Lairs

quests.title: Hold the Line
quests.text: Gryan Stoutmantle needs the field held while Sentinel Hill regroups. Survive ten minutes in Westfall, whatever comes.

quests.title: Carrion Skies
quests.text: Vultros picks the Brotherhood’s leavings clean and nests above the Dagger Hills. Clear the skies over Westfall.

quests.title: Proven in Westfall
quests.text: Gryan Stoutmantle trusts only those who have grown strong in the field. Reach level 18 in a single run in Westfall.

quests.title: Echeyakee
quests.text: Echeyakee prowls the tall grass outside the Crossroads. Hunt the great cat before it takes another caravan.

quests.title: Bounty: Kolkar Wranglers
quests.text: Kolkar Wranglers keep coming at the Crossroads. Thork pays for every thirty you put down, as often as you bring proof.

quests.title: Break the Lairs
quests.text: Four lairs ring the battlefield, each held by a champion. Break three of them and the Crossroads sleeps easier.

quests.title: Hold the Line
quests.text: Thork needs the field held while the Crossroads regroups. Survive ten minutes in The Barrens, whatever comes.

quests.title: Bloodmark
quests.text: Hezrul Bloodmark leads the Kolkar against the Crossroads. Cut the head from the snake.

quests.title: Proven in The Barrens
quests.text: Thork trusts only those who have grown strong in the field. Reach level 18 in a single run in The Barrens.

quests.title: The Foreman
quests.text: Rhahk’Zor drives the Brotherhood’s miners under Moonbrook. Smash through the foreman and the tunnels are open.

quests.title: Bounty: Defias Watchmen
quests.text: Defias Watchmen keep coming at Moonbrook. Captain Danuvin pays for every thirty you put down, as often as you bring proof.

quests.title: Break the Lairs
quests.text: Four lairs ring the battlefield, each held by a champion. Break three of them and Moonbrook sleeps easier.

quests.title: Hold the Line
quests.text: Captain Danuvin needs the field held while Moonbrook regroups. Survive ten minutes in The Deadmines, whatever comes.

quests.title: VanCleef
quests.text: Edwin VanCleef commands the Defias from a ship hidden deep in the mine. Finish the Brotherhood for good.

quests.title: Proven in The Deadmines
quests.text: Captain Danuvin trusts only those who have grown strong in the field. Reach level 20 in a single run in The Deadmines.

quests.title: The Fanglords
quests.text: The Druids of the Fang twisted Naralex’s dream into a nightmare. Lady Anacondra leads them; begin with her.

quests.title: Bounty: Deviate Slayers
quests.text: Deviate Slayers keep coming at the Lushwater Oasis. Nalpak pays for every thirty you put down, as often as you bring proof.

quests.title: Break the Lairs
quests.text: Four lairs ring the battlefield, each held by a champion. Break three of them and the Lushwater Oasis sleeps easier.

quests.title: Hold the Line
quests.text: Nalpak needs the field held while the Lushwater Oasis regroups. Survive ten minutes in Wailing Caverns, whatever comes.

quests.title: The Devourer
quests.text: Mutanus the Devourer rises from the nightmare itself. Slay it, and Naralex may finally wake.

quests.title: Proven in Wailing Caverns
quests.text: Nalpak trusts only those who have grown strong in the field. Reach level 20 in a single run in Wailing Caverns.

quests.title: The Spectral Wolf
quests.text: Lupos stalks the road to Darkshire and no caravan has passed in a week. Hunt it down.

quests.title: Bounty: Skeletal Mages
quests.text: Skeletal Mages keep coming at Darkshire. Commander Althea Ebonlocke pays for every thirty you put down, as often as you bring proof.

quests.title: Break the Lairs
quests.text: Four lairs ring the battlefield, each held by a champion. Break three of them and Darkshire sleeps easier.

quests.title: Hold the Line
quests.text: Commander Althea Ebonlocke needs the field held while Darkshire regroups. Survive ten minutes in Duskwood, whatever comes.

quests.title: Nightbane
quests.text: Nefaru leads the Nightbane worgen against Darkshire’s walls. The Night Watch needs this ended.

quests.title: Proven in Duskwood
quests.text: Commander Althea Ebonlocke trusts only those who have grown strong in the field. Reach level 22 in a single run in Duskwood.

quests.title: Iron in the Forest
quests.text: The Venture Co. levels Stonetalon’s forests with machines like XT:4. Stop the machines and the men who run them.

quests.title: Bounty: Venture Co. Loggers
quests.text: Venture Co. Loggers keep coming at Sun Rock Retreat. Seereth Stonebreak pays for every thirty you put down, as often as you bring proof.

quests.title: Break the Lairs
quests.text: Four lairs ring the battlefield, each held by a champion. Break three of them and Sun Rock Retreat sleeps easier.

quests.title: Hold the Line
quests.text: Seereth Stonebreak needs the field held while Sun Rock Retreat regroups. Survive ten minutes in Stonetalon Mountains, whatever comes.

quests.title: Windshear Crag
quests.text: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle runs the whole operation from Windshear Crag. Shut him down.

quests.title: Proven in Stonetalon Mountains
quests.text: Seereth Stonebreak trusts only those who have grown strong in the field. Reach level 22 in a single run in Stonetalon Mountains.

quests.title: The Uncatchable
quests.text: Sin’Dall, the tiger no hunter has caught, prowls the northern jungle. Be the first.

quests.title: Bounty: Lashtail Raptors
quests.text: Lashtail Raptors keep coming at the Rebel Camp. Lieutenant Doren pays for every thirty you put down, as often as you bring proof.

quests.title: Break the Lairs

quests.title: Hold the Line
quests.text: Lieutenant Doren needs the field held while the Rebel Camp regroups. Survive ten minutes in Stranglethorn Vale, whatever comes.

quests.title: King of the Jungle
quests.text: King Bangalash rules the panthers of Stranglethorn. Only the greatest hunters come back with his pelt.

quests.title: Proven in Stranglethorn Vale
quests.text: Lieutenant Doren trusts only those who have grown strong in the field. Reach level 25 in a single run in Stranglethorn Vale.
